data.title: Mars Impact Fund Commits $3M to Worldwide Veterinary Service for Rabies Elimination in Thailand
data.description: On World Rabies Day, Mars, Incorporated is celebrating a partnership with Worldwide Veterinary Service (WVS) to support final-mile rabies elimination in Thailand. data.title: Decoding ‘medical innovation’: driving Thailand’s economy and transforming healthcare
data.description: Amid the dual pressures of a rapidly ageing society and a sharp rise in non-communicable diseases (NCDs), Thailand faces a critical challenge: optimising public healthcare budgets to ensure all citizens have equal, life-saving access to modern medical care. A high-level multi-stakeholder policy dialogue titled “Advancing Thailand’s Medical Economy through Health Innovation,” was convened in Bangkok by the US-Asean Business Council in early September this year, marked a significant milestone in shaping the country’s healthcare economy through international collaboration. Attended by officials from the US Embassy, health economics experts, healthcare professionals and global life sciences leaders, the forum outlined a vision to transform the nation’s healthcare landscape in the long term.

data.title: True Digital Park’s “Hello, Connecting to New Possibilities” Wins Influencer Award
data.description: Reinforcing its role as a tech and startup ecosystem that connects people, businesses, and opportunities from around the world, True Digital Park, Southeast Asia’s largest tech and startup hub, has won the Best Property & Real Estate Influencer Campaign at the Thailand Influencer Awards 2026, recognising the success of its “Hello, Connecting to New Possibilities” campaign. Built around the simple yet powerful idea of “Hello” as the starting point for new connections, the campaign highlights how meaningful connections can open doors to new opportunities, support business growth, expand partnerships, and strengthen the technology community. It also reflects True Digital Park’s role as a hub that brings together people, businesses, technology, and new possibilities under the concept of “One Roof, All Possibilities”.
